summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread(callback, *args, **kwargs) in src/textual/app.py. It runs the callback on the app's event loop from another thread and blocks until it returns (awaiting coroutine callbacks). The app records its loop and thread id in _process_messages. It raises RuntimeError if the app isn't running or if called from the app's own thread (to avoid deadlock). Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 5 tests. The venv lacks an async pytest plugin, so I ran the tests with a standalone runner in /tmp: all 7 async tests (the 5 new ones plus the 2 existing call-later tests) passed. Pytest itself fails async tests in this environment, which I did not fix since I couldn't install packages. Nothing was committed.
